About

Loveleen Pereira is a multidisciplinary creative based in India, with two years of dynamic experience in creative strategy, storytelling, and brand building. Having worked with global brands and startups, Loveleen's expertise spans content direction, marketing, and design. Loveleen excels at connecting brands with culture, making them distinctive and memorable.
